drafts.name: Do not speculate, incorporate estimates, or send ambiguity (preference)
drafts.description: Standing user preference: Do not speculate, incorporate estimates, or send ambiguity downstream.

drafts.name: Every plan from the Setting Manager must include (preference)
drafts.description: Standing user preference: Every plan from the Setting Manager must include Wall 5 plus one Main Wall.

drafts.name: uncertainty-must-surface-not-pass-through
drafts.description: Any form of uncertainty encountered at a planning pipeline stage — incomplete data, contradictory entries, unverified estimates, or ambiguity — must be surfaced as an explicit halt or named alert and never absorbed, glossed over, or forwarded downstream. Downstream consumers must receive only complete, verified, non-contradictory inputs.

drafts.name: hard-stop-over-graceful-degradation
drafts.description: When a planning system encounters an unmet hard constraint — insufficient inventory, missing required data, contradictory status — the correct response is an explicit, named halt. Gracefully degrading (producing a reduced plan, skipping a required element, improvising values) masks the violation and perpetuates operational errors downstream. Halt loudly; do not silently produce a diminished success.

drafts.name: quartermaster-no-override-by-operational-pressure
drafts.description: Halt conditions and authenticated-data requirements for the Quartermaster role cannot be waived by deadline urgency, marketing commitments, stakeholder informal estimates, or 'fix later' rationale.

drafts.name: Always use fixed consumption values — no improvisation (preference)
drafts.description: Standing user preference: Always use fixed consumption values — no improvisation, no creative reductions.

drafts.name: quartermaster-hold-inventory-status-assessment
drafts.description: Calculate holds required from a Wall Setting Plan using fixed consumption standards (500/Main Wall, 100/Wall 5) and compare against clean available inventory to emit HOLD_OK, HOLD_LOW, or HOLD_CRITICAL_LOW.

drafts.name: Inventory counts include only clean, ready-to-use holds; dirty (preference)
drafts.description: Standing user preference: Inventory counts include only clean, ready-to-use holds; dirty, damaged, or inspection-pending holds are excluded — inflated counts to mask shortages are not permitted.

drafts.name: Do not schedule until complete, confirmed data is (preference)
drafts.description: Standing user preference: Do not schedule until complete, confirmed data is available — preliminary data is not sufficient.

drafts.name: fixed-constants-over-contextual-estimation
drafts.description: Operational planning pipelines that consume finite, countable resources must use pre-agreed, fixed consumption constants rather than context-sensitive estimates, creative reductions, or per-cycle improvisations. Fixed constants ensure auditability, prevent shortfall masking, and make consumption predictable and comparable across planning cycles.

drafts.name: Optimistic planning is not tolerated: if holds run (preference)
drafts.description: Standing user preference: Optimistic planning is not tolerated: if holds run out, the week's setting stops; reality takes precedence over convenience.

drafts.name: Always produce an Inventory Status report with a (preference)
drafts.description: Standing user preference: Always produce an Inventory Status report with a status code and numerical breakdown, and apply the hard-stop rule where appropriate.

drafts.name: quartermaster-wall-selection-policy
drafts.description: Select exactly one Main Wall (Walls 1–4) for the weekly reset using the age-noncompliance-first, then oldest-wall tiebreak rule, applying the 42-day threshold verbatim.

drafts.name: quartermaster-plan-inconsistency-alert
drafts.description: Issue PLAN_INCONSISTENCY_ALERT and halt all downstream processing when the Wall Status report contains contradictory entries or Wall 5 data is missing, identifying the exact anomaly.
